policies.title: Withdraw from ECHR
policies.statement: Repeal the Human Rights Act and withdraw from the European Convention on Human Rights to enable deportation of individuals without a right to remain in the UK.

policies.title: Resume North Sea drilling
policies.statement: Remove legal obstacles preventing approval of new oil and gas projects in the North Sea through a Get Britain Drilling Bill.

policies.title: Welfare spending cuts
policies.statement: Reinstate the two-child benefit cap in full and restrict disability payments to those with lower-level mental health conditions.

policies.title: Tax cuts
policies.statement: Cut state spending to deliver tax cuts, including complete abolition of stamp duty.

policies.title: Increase policing
policies.statement: Hire 10,000 additional police officers and triple stop-and-search powers to tackle crime.

policies.title: Scrap business rates
policies.statement: Remove business rates for high street businesses and repeal recent workers' rights reforms.
